title: baking LIghtMapGI crashes
body:
### Tested versions

-reproducible in: 4.4.1, 4.5-dev4

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev4 - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 27 May 2025 14:06:25 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (RADV NAVI22) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

Godot crashes every time I try to bake a lightmap. I always try baking with the lowest preset.
When I bake without directional lighting, I get to 70%. With directional lighting, I only get to 32%, and then it crashes.

1. make a map that is bigger than a simple plane (for example maps/test_1.tscn)
2. try to bake lightmapgi
